rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing or saying something with remorse.

example.english: I remorsefully apologized to the victim.
example.traditional: 我內疚咁同受害人道歉。
example.jyutping: ngo5 noi6 gau3 gam3 tung4 sau6 hoi6 jan4 dou6 hip3

rows.note: Use this when the remorse is being presented specifically as regret over what happened or what one did.

example.english: I remorsefully admitted that I had done wrong that day.
example.traditional: 我後悔咁承認自己嗰日做錯咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hau6 fui3 gam3 sing4 jing6 zi6 gei2 go2 jat6 zou6 co3 zo2
